notes.title: Quality of More Update
notes.content: [p]Features include:[/p][p][/p][p]20+ New Anomalies, including 6 new entities.[/p][p]A fully custom FPS limiter, no more GPU explosions.[/p][p]Many bugfixes, including Haunts not having anomalies assigned right, anomalies being assigned to the wrong report type, and some anomalies just not appearing at all.[/p][p][/p][p]Both maps have received new content and new entities, Have fun finding them all![/p]
